allowed_agent_operator_types.description: The agent operator types this contract admits. Neutrality is by configuration: the enum is the governance boundary of recognised types, and the contract selects a non-empty subset of it. No maximum, so admitting a further governance-recognised provider is a contract edit, not a schema edit.

allowed_session_families.description: The session families this contract admits, selected from the governance boundary enum. Non-empty, no maximum, for the same reason as allowed_agent_operator_types.

typedOperatorIdentity.description: The full operator vocabulary, including the human owner. Governance boundary for any operator identity; not directly usable as a review operator — see agentOperatorIdentity.

agentOperatorIdentity.description: An operator identity restricted to agent operator types. Enforces the contract's review_operator_must_be_agent_operator_type / human_owner_may_act_as_review_operator: false at the schema layer, so a human_owner review operator fails before the validator is reached. Narrows typedOperatorIdentity rather than duplicating it, keeping one definition of the operator shape.
